decisions.reason: The operator line is a heavily invested and publicly featured pillar of the firm's one-source garage door offering, so management keeps defending it even though it has not been observed on the website since 2019.

The solid wood door is a low-visibility niche product that has not appeared on the website since 2018 and is a natural candidate for rationalization, but it still supports the customization promise and weak demand can be blamed on pandemic-era disruption.
Dropping the remote-controlled operator would call into question the justification for the broader operator investment, so management keeps it despite its low visibility.

Glazed industrial doors belong to the committed core industrial range, and the firm already showed it was willing to prune when it withdrew Product E, but this variant is still defended as part of that range.
As a prominently presented launch with its own page and sunk development and marketing costs, the door stays, and soft results are attributed to temporary construction-market and supply-chain issues.
